verses.text: What causes fights and arguments among you? Do they not come from the selfish desires that battle inside you?
You want things, but you do not get them. So you kill and you are jealous, but you still cannot get what you want. So you argue and fight. You do not have what you want because you do not ask God.
And when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask for the wrong reasons. You only want to spend it on your own pleasures.
You are unfaithful to God! Do you not know that being a friend of the world means being an enemy of God? Anyone who chooses to be a friend of the world becomes God's enemy.
Do you think the Scripture means nothing when it says that the Spirit God put in us longs for us jealously?
But God gives us even more kindness. That is why the Scripture says, "God is against the proud, but he is kind to the humble."
So give yourselves to God. Stand against the devil, and he will run away from you.
Come close to God, and he will come close to you. Wash your hands, you sinners. Make your hearts pure, you who cannot decide between God and the world.
Be sad, cry and weep. Let your laughing turn into crying, and your joy into sadness.
Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up.

Brothers and sisters, do not speak against each other. Anyone who speaks against a brother or sister, or judges them, speaks against God's law and judges it. And if you judge the law, you are not obeying it. You are acting like its judge.
There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the one who can save and destroy. So who are you to judge your neighbour?
Now listen, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we will go to this city, stay there for a year, do business and make money."
You do not even know what will happen tomorrow. What is your life? You are like a mist that appears for a little while and then disappears.
Instead, you should say, "If the Lord wants us to, we will live and do this or that."
But now you are proud and boast. All boasting like that is evil.
So if anyone knows the good they should do and does not do it, they are sinning.
